````text
# #3557: Patch: Stinkyscape+ S18, spells on existing primitives
Opened by @squishy-squooby.

Part of fullsend 1 of the Stinkyscape+ set (#3534, tracker #3533). It builds the set's spells that need little that is new, and the Ayys.

The plan: [`docs/stinkyscape-plus-set.md`](https://github.com/jlore-studios/jackioh/blob/claude/laughing-wright-eaibe9/docs/stinkyscape-plus-set.md) (SP5, SP6, SP8, SP10); the designer's list: [`JackiOh_StinkyscapePlus_Cards.md`](https://github.com/jlore-studios/jackioh/blob/claude/laughing-wright-eaibe9/JackiOh_StinkyscapePlus_Cards.md). Both are on the planning branch `claude/laughing-wright-eaibe9` until the foundation (#3535) brings them onto this fullsend's branch. Where they disagree with SPEC, SPEC wins (CLAUDE.md). `{For AI: …}` notes in the designer's text are the designer's notes to you, the builder, not to the game's AI (SP5).

## Cards

| # | Card |
| --- | --- |
| #20 | B-Patch |
| #24 | Forced Propagation |
| #32 | Z-Patch |
| #51 | Chains Bind Me |
| #68 | Shadiris Visions |
| #76 | Ayys LMAO |
| #76.1 | Ayy |
| #85 | Body Snatch |
| #94 | PIP |
| #103 | Transcend |
| #104 | Tireless Cultivation |
| #105 | Spacersi |
| #158 | Quick Chaos |

## What it builds on

- The foundation (#3535): every card's catalog entry, both faces and a stub script.
- E6 (#3550): the kill deadline (PIP).
- Buff and Nerf, Transform, Dormant, Cast on draw (§6.3).

## Readings (defaults; change one only with a ruling note)

- #20 B-Patch: one 50/50 roll for the whole effect, not one per card. A card that can't be Buffed or Nerfed is skipped.
- #24 Forced Propagation: (1), and (3) when embiggened, which shuffles 40 copies instead of 10. The copies are fresh (no cost changes or buffs), and the Radiant face Buffs each once.
- #32 Z-Patch: Tradable. It Buffs every permanent 5 times, then Nerfs every permanent (Radiant: every enemy permanent) 5 times. Its flavor text is "Watchu know about the Z patch?"
- #76 Ayys LMAO: "Small Asteroids" are Stinkyscape's Tiny Asteroid. Each of the three is an Ayy or a Tiny Asteroid at random, Cloaked. Ayys go to the backrow when a backrow zone is free (the designer's note), where they are Units for every rule (E3's Flexible placement).
- #85 Body Snatch: the Ayy is #76.1. The base face puts it in Defense Position.
- #94 PIP: E6's kill deadline. The Radiant face adds 3 The Coin when it fails.
- #103, #104, #105: "Transform into ones that cost (1) more" picks a random permanent of the same type costing exactly one more, or the closest higher cost when none exists. #104 is a Spell (the list gives no type).
- #158 Quick Chaos: "cast a random spell" draws from the collectible Spells of the shipped sets, with random targets.

## The designer's text, verbatim

```text
**(1) B-Patch, Spell, Epic, Stinkyscape+, #20**
**Cast on draw:** Randomly either **buff** or **nerf** *{50/50}*, every card on the field and in both hands
~~~
**Cast on draw:** Randomly either **buff** or **nerf** *{50/50}*, every card on the field and in both hands, **Lucky 1**

**(1 embiggen 3) Forced Propagation, Spell, Epic, Stinkyscape+, #24**
Choose a non-**fused** card in your hand or field, shuffle 10 embiggen 40 copies of a card into your deck *{does no preserve cost changes or buffs on them}*
~~~
Choose a non-**fused** card in your hand or field, shuffle 10 embiggen 40 copies of a card into your deck, then **buff** them *{does no preserve cost changes or buffs on them}*

**(3) Z-Patch, Spell, Epic, Stinkyscape+, #32**
**Tradable**
Buff every permanent 5 times. Then Nerf every permanent 5 times.
~~~
**Tradable**
Buff every permanent 5 times. Then Nerf every enemy permanent 5 times.
{Flavor text: “Watchu know about the Z patch?”}

**(2) Chains Bind Me, Spell, Common, Stinkyscape+, #51**
**Dormant** a permanent for 2 turns. When it awakens, Buff it 2 times if it’s yours or Nerf it 2 times if it’s an enemy’s.
~~~
**Dormant** a permanent for 2 turns. When it awakens, Buff it 5 times if it’s yours or Nerf it 5 times if it’s an enemy’s.

**(1) Shadiris Visions, Spell, Rare, Stinkyscape+, #68**
**Discover** a **Spell** in your deck; add a copy of it to your hand
~~~
**Discover** a **Spell** in your deck; add a **Radiant** copy of it to your hand, it costs (1) less

**(2) Ayys LMAO, Spell, Common, Stinkyscape+, #76**
Summon a mix of 3 **Cloaked** **Ayy** tokens or **Cloaked** **Small Asteroids**. {For AI: The Ayys spawn in the backrow if possible.}
~~~
Summon a mix of 3 Radiant **Cloaked Ayy** tokens or **Cloaked** **Small Asteroids**.

**(1) Ayy, Unit, Token, Common, Stinkyscape+, #76.1**
2/2
**Cloaked**
~~~
4/4
**Cloaked**
**Poisonous**

**(2) Body Snatch, Spell, Rare, Stinkyscape+, #85**
Transform a Unit into an **Ayy** in defense position.
~~~
Transform a Unit into an **Ayy**.

**(1) PIP, Spell, Rare, Stinkyscape+, #94**
Put a Unit on a performance enhancement plan, they have 1 turn to get a kill otherwise they are destroyed.
~~~
Put a Unit on a performance enhancement plan, they have 1 turn to get a kill otherwise they are destroyed. If they fail, add 3 **The Coins** to your hand.

**(1) Transcend, Spell, Common, Stinkyscape+, #103**
Transform your permanents into ones that cost (1) more.
~~~
Transform your permanents into ones that cost (2) more.

**(1) Tireless Cultivation, Rare, Stinkyscape+, #104**
**Temporary 1**
Transform a permanent into one that costs (1) more.
**End of Turn**: Return this to your hand.
~~~
**Temporary 2**
Transform a permanent into one that costs (2) more.
**End of Turn**: Return this to your hand.

**(3) Spacersi, Unit, Common, Stinkyscape+, #105**
5/8
**Cry**: Transform your other Units into ones that cost (1) more.
~~~
10/16
**Cry**: Transform your other Units into ones that cost (2) more.

**(1) Quick Chaos, Spell, Rare, Stinkyscape+, #158**
**Cast on draw:** cast a random spell *{targets chosen randomly}*
~~~
**Cast on draw:** cast a random **Radiant** spell *{targets chosen randomly}*
```

## Done when

- [ ] Every card above plays its base and Radiant faces by its text and the readings, in its own script file (`crates/cards/src/scripts/stinkyscape_plus/cNNN_slug.rs`, the stub the foundation made), with tests for both faces in the same file (CLAUDE.md rules 5 and 6). `docs/ADDING_CARDS.md` was read first (rule 10).
- [ ] Every number is a named constant or a card `param` (rule 9). A script reads state only through the prelude's helpers. A missing verb or board fact goes into the engine with its test (CLAUDE.md, Architecture).
- [ ] Each decision the spec doesn't make has a ruling note numbered in this issue's block, a test named after it, and its paragraph in `spec/pending/<this issue>.md` (rule 3). The cards' §8 rows say what was built.
- [ ] Every prompt these cards open is answered by the AI, the random policy and the timeout.
- [ ] `cargo test -p jackioh-cards` passes for these cards, and `cargo jackioh catalog check`, `spec check` and `names --check` pass.
- [ ] Only these cards' catalog entries and §8 rows are edited (other parts edit theirs side by side), and the set stays `Held`: players see nothing until the release (part R).

Blocked by #3550

Part of #3534.
````
